This '''Hutt [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]]''' resided on [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]] prior to the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]]. Although the Hutt illegally bought a trafficked [[Wampa/Legends|wampa]] as a guard animal, the creature ended up [[Death/Legends|killing]] the [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] and would have killed one of the Hutt's [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]], [[Aayla Secura/Legends|Aayla Secura]], had [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Quinlan Vos/Legends|Quinlan Vos]] not intervened.
